posts.content:
Ran a geo-holdout across 12 cities. One channel dropped. Topline didn't move.

That's incrementality. Not last-click attribution games.

Once you've seen a channel vanish from the data and the business not notice — you stop arguing about platform-reported ROAS and start asking harder questions.

The uncomfortable truth: most paid media teams are optimising for attribution, not growth.

15,000 property videos in 6 weeks. Here's what nobody tells you about AI creative at scale:

The generation is the easy part. The filter is everything.

We built a real-time ML scoring model that checks every image before it hits creative rotation. Bad angle, wrong lighting, messy listing — filtered out before the auction.

Result: zero bad-image escalations. Down from weekly firefighting.

Co-founded Flex EV. Scaled to 700+ vehicles and ₹40L/month in 12 months.

Then made a deliberate decision to step back.

Not a failure. A choice.

The lesson nobody tells you about startups: sometimes the most operator move is recognising when to consolidate your learning and go build something bigger. Took the scars. Used them.
